# Rifaat Kouaider — Healthcare IT Consulting

> Independent healthcare IT consultant for medical practices across the United States. EMR/EHR migrations, PACS imaging systems, VOIP phone systems, cloud migration, network infrastructure, Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace, and AI tools for practices. Computer Engineer with 10+ years in healthcare technology; 50+ practices served.

## Services

- [EMR Replacement](https://kouaider.com/#services): Structured EMR/EHR migrations that minimize downtime, protect patient data, and ensure staff adoption from day one.
- [PACS Solutions](https://kouaider.com/#services): Picture Archiving and Communication Systems tailored to imaging workflow and long-term storage requirements.
- [VOIP Solutions](https://kouaider.com/#services): Scalable, cost-effective VOIP phone systems designed for clinical environments.
- [Cloud Migration](https://kouaider.com/#services): Secure, phased moves from on-premise infrastructure to the cloud with minimal disruption to daily operations.
- [Network Infrastructure](https://kouaider.com/#services): Design, installation, and maintenance of robust networks for healthcare environments, from new builds to full overhauls.
- [Organization Productivity Suites](https://kouaider.com/#services): Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace deployment and management to streamline collaboration across the practice.
- [Technology Strategy](https://kouaider.com/#services): Actionable IT roadmaps aligned with clinical workflows, compliance requirements, and growth objectives.
- [AI Tools](https://kouaider.com/#services): AI-powered phone systems, smart scheduling, clinical transcription, admin automation, and practical AI use policies.
- [Active Directory & Identity Management](https://kouaider.com/#services): User access, credentials, and multi-layer security protocols across the organization.
- [Technology Roadmaps](https://kouaider.com/#services): Long-term technology planning bridging clinical operations, compliance standards, and business objectives.
- [Vendor & Third-Party Management](https://kouaider.com/#services): Vendor relationships, service contracts, and escalations handled on the practice's behalf.

## Interactive Tools

- [IT Health Check](https://kouaider.com/it-health-check.html): 7-question assessment giving medical practices an honest read on their technology, with scored tiers and recommendations. Results can be emailed.
- [Cost of Doing Nothing](https://kouaider.com/roi-calculator.html): ROI calculator estimating what IT friction and downtime cost a practice per year.
- [Ransomware Response Sheet](https://kouaider.com/ransomware-response.html): One-page emergency sheet — the first five calls to make when ransomware hits a practice. Printable PDF: https://kouaider.com/ransomware-response-sheet.pdf

## Blog & Podcast

- [Blog](https://kouaider.com/blog/): Weekly plainspoken takes on healthcare IT, cybersecurity, and AI for medical practices.
- [Kouaider Briefing](https://worker-1.rifaat-kouaider.workers.dev/feed): Weekly podcast — each blog post as a short narrated episode.

## About

Rifaat Kouaider is a Computer Engineer and healthcare technology consultant with over a decade of hands-on experience spanning IT infrastructure, systems engineering, and software product development. As Product Owner & Partner at HealthSpaces, he has worked with medical practices across the United States to design, implement, and optimize technology systems.
